title: Typed IR implementation mapping
summary: Exact M0 map of the partial declarative AST, coarse Markdown node and render registries.
current_behavior: DocumentParser emits immutable MarkdownNode and SmartCallNode objects with line-range SourceSpan values.
A block resolver registry and a renderer registry fail closed for unknown registered types.
Headings and links are separately inspected for metadata.
Ordinary Markdown is still passed as one coarse string to PortableMarkdownRenderer.
known_deviations: The current AST can be serialized in receipts, but the target permits no mandatory page-level JSON/JSONL.
Required native block and inline node types do not exist in Document IR.
SourceSpan has source/start/end lines but no required column.
PortableMarkdownRenderer performs a second parse plus component-specific HTML rendering behind the coarse node.
Badge calls inside example code fences are not component nodes.
deletion_gates: Delete MarkdownNode only after typed block/inline coverage and exact badge parity.
Retire PortableMarkdownRenderer component logic only after every moved node renderer has positive, negative and source-location tests.
Delete duplicate metadata parsing only after headings and links are derived from the canonical IR.
